title: WAL callback frame consumption

scope.rationale: sqlite3WalCallback returns the frame count recorded by the most recent commit since the prior callback read and clears the pending value, while null WAL returns zero.

external_source_responsibilities: Successful commit publication and connection hook dispatch
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete consume-and-clear body is assigned; writeFrames records the committed terminal frame and public hook dispatch remains open.

outputs: Pending callback frame number or zero
contracts.ownership: Mutates only the pending scalar callback value.
contracts.state_and_results: Null returns zero. Non-null returns callback_frame exactly and clears it to zero, so repeated reads return zero until another commit.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Does not invoke the hook or perform I/O; caller synchronization external.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure path; consumption is one-shot.

representation_differences: The bounded Wal field is named callback_frame instead of iCallback; the result remains u32 until the eventual C API boundary.

oracle.protocol: Observe zero for null, seed 17, observe 17, then observe zero on repeat.
oracle.normalization: Frame count and zero sentinel are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; hook dispatch synchronization external.
assurance.continuation: Repeated consumption remains zero until a later commit publishes a frame.

integration.native_call_path: Successful bounded commit records callback_frame and typed accessor consumes it; connection hook dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires connection hook integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Verify commit/failure publication timing against pinned C.
